caveats: Day-of-year thresholds/climatology come from baseline pools spanning 1991-12-27 to 2003-01-05 (baseline years 1992-2002 widened by the +/-5-calendar-day windows, per the specified method). Per-cell MHWs were detected over the target period only. The region contains 292 land/non-sea cells (masked 0); 3308 sea cells were analysed. Sea cells were required to have finite SST on every target day. One regional event found: 2012-08-15 to 2012-08-19, with 26 cells in a per-cell MHW on those days.
